item.anima.debug_wand.no_identity: That agent has no identity yet
item.anima.debug_wand.no_selection: Nobody selected — right-click an agent first
anima.config.option.limits.reads_per_tic: How many blocks one Person may read each tick. The main performance dial.
anima.config.option.limits.queue_cap.des: How many spotted-but-unexamined columns may back up before new sightings are dropped.
anima.config.option.limits.region_max_bl: Block budget for scanning one structure; hitting it leaves the region marked as only partly known.
anima.config.option.limits.region_cache_: How much of the world's shape one world remembers on everyone's behalf, so that fifty settlers in one wood don't each scan the same trees. They still notice and remember their own trees — they just stop re-measuring them. Counted in blocks; 0 turns it off.
anima.config.option.limits.rays_per_tick: Total line-of-sight checks every agent on the server may spend between them each tick. At the ceiling they notice things a little later rather than not at all — refused checks are deferred, never dropped.
anima.config.option.limits.ray_budget.de: Base line-of-sight checks per Person per tick. The real budget grows with the backlog, so a large wave of mobs is noticed within a few ticks — checks are deferred, never skipped.
anima.config.option.claims.ttl_ticks.des: How long a claimed work site outlives its last heartbeat before another Person may take the spot. 20 ticks is one second.
anima.config.option.journal.max_entries_: How many journal entries each Person keeps. Older ones are dropped once it fills.
anima.config.option.journal.max_age_tick: How old a journal entry may get before it is dropped. The default is 10 minutes of game time.
anima.config.option.journal.sweep_interv: How often the journal clears out entries that have aged past their lifetime.
anima.config.option.journal.file_sink.de: Also mirror each agent's journal to logs/anima/agent-<id>.log on disk.
anima.config.aspect.mind.stickiness.desc: Bonus added to whatever the Person is already doing, so small swings in pressure don't leave them dithering between two urges.
anima.config.aspect.mind.preempt.desc: How much raw pressure a new urge needs before it may cut into a task already under way.
anima.config.aspect.instincts.flee_range: Distance in blocks at which a threat starts to register at all.
Distance in blocks over which fear ramps from nothing to full panic.
anima.config.aspect.instincts.flee_appro: Extra fear when a threat is measurably closing in — the observable stand-in for "it is hunting me".
anima.config.aspect.instincts.wander_idl: The do-something floor: every real drive must beat this. At 0 an unbothered Person simply stands still.
anima.config.aspect.instincts.wander_rad: How far, in blocks, an idle saunter may pick its next stop.
anima.config.aspect.senses.radius.desc: How far away, in blocks, another being can be perceived at all.
anima.config.aspect.senses.sneak_range_m: Shrinks the range at which a sneaking being is noticed. Sneaking shortens how far away you are spotted; it never makes you invisible.
Horizontal field of view in degrees. Beings outside it go unseen until they make noise; 360 sees in every direction.
anima.config.aspect.senses.vertical_degr: Half-angle in degrees above and below where the Person is looking — human sight is wide but flat. 90 removes the up/down limit.
anima.config.aspect.senses.hearing_radiu: How far away, in blocks, noise-makers are noticed regardless of the view cone. Sneaking beings are silent; 0 makes a Person deaf.
Object permanence: how long a being stays perceived — frozen as last remembered — after both sight and sound have gone quiet.
anima.config.aspect.senses.heard_activit: How long an activity known only by sound — heard mining, a heard scuffle — stays believed after the noise stops. Afterwards only the bare presence is left.
anima.config.aspect.senses.near_interval: How often, in ticks, a being standing right there is re-checked.
anima.config.aspect.senses.far_interval_: How often, in ticks, a being at the edge of range is re-checked. Distances in between fall between the two.
anima.config.aspect.senses.attack_decay_: How long being attacked keeps something read as hostile, with or without a face on it. Much longer than the other senses on purpose: forgetting an attack fifteen seconds later is amnesia, not object permanence.
anima.config.aspect.senses.herd_link_rad: How far apart two animals of the same species may stand and still count as one herd. Herds link in chains, so a spread-out pasture still joins up.
anima.config.aspect.places.radius.desc: Horizontal sensing radius in blocks, within the cone below. Cost grows with its square — a walking Person sweeps about 2R columns per block moved.
Field of view in degrees for noticing places beyond the halo below. Narrowing it is what pays for the radius above, and is why a Person no longer notices a tree squarely behind them. 360 notices in every direction at every distance.
anima.config.aspect.places.near_radius.d: Radius in blocks within which places are noticed whichever way a Person faces — what you are standing next to, rather than what you are looking at.
anima.config.aspect.places.horizon_radiu: How far a Person makes out the gist of what is out there — a forest, not a tree. Sight rays are marched out to it, and it sets both how long they are and how many make up a fan, so raising it costs more than proportionally; the work is paid for out of whatever the near field left unspent, so what a longer reach really buys is how often the whole view is fresh. Set at or below the sense radius to switch it off.
anima.config.aspect.places.see_through_r: How far a Person's eye resolves a see-through thing — a canopy, a water surface — into its parts. Nearer than this they look between the branches; further off the same canopy is a wall the skyline stops at, which is why a Person standing in a wood can barely see out of it. 0 means they never see into anything.
anima.config.aspect.places.region_max_sp: How far a scan may spread from where it began — what splits one fused mega-forest into separate groves.
How many places of each kind a Person remembers before the stalest is forgotten. Must exceed the trees they work among, or edge trees are forgotten and rediscovered forever.
anima.config.aspect.danger.melee_mult.de: Danger multiplier for a visibly held melee weapon — a zombie with a sword outranks bare claws.
anima.config.aspect.danger.ranged_mult.d: Danger multiplier for a visibly held ranged weapon: bow, crossbow or trident.
Danger multiplier for visible armor on the body.
Danger multiplier for a mounted body, such as a skeleton riding a spider or a horse.
anima.config.aspect.danger.baby_mult.des: Danger multiplier for a baby variant — smaller, faster and harder to hit.
anima.config.aspect.social.hail_radius.d: How far away, in blocks, a shouted hail is heard. A hail has to carry further than sight or it would add nothing to simply noticing someone. This also sizes a Person's ear; quieter sounds are still limited to the hearing range.
anima.config.aspect.body.height.desc: How many blocks of headroom this body needs to walk through a space. A settler is 2; something one block tall squeezes under what a settler must walk around.
anima.config.aspect.body.jump_height.des: How many blocks this body can jump straight up. 0 means every step up is a wall to find a way around.
anima.config.aspect.body.max_drop.desc: How far this body will willingly drop. Anything deeper reads as a hole to route around, and the same number decides what counts as a ledge to tread carefully near.
anima.config.aspect.body.max_leap.desc: The widest gap this body can jump across. 1 is a walking jump; 2 and 3 need a sprint run-up. 3 is vanilla's sprint-jump limit.
anima.config.aspect.body.can_swim.desc: Whether this body will enter and cross water. Off keeps water impassable, so it routes around instead. Surface crossing only.
